rawBlockNode.name: sec1desc
rawBlockNode.content: Built upon fundamental metamaterials research at Duke University, Kymeta's disruptive technology is supported by a world-class R&D facility, and a team that includes some of the brightest minds in the industry. Together, we are building and delivering an Intelligent Communications Platform to enable network access and spatial intelligence, anytime and everywhere.

children.name: yearDesc
children.content: Physicist Victor Veselago, Ph.D., publishes an analysis stating that materials could be created to have both negative permittivity and permeability. This theoretical material does not exist in nature, but Veselago's research shows the remarkable properties such a material would possess.

rawBlockNode.name: sub
rawBlockNode.content: We are united by a common vision and key values, informed by shared principles that guide our work today and into the future.

children.content: Securing the future with revolutionary technology.
Leveraging our disruptive technology, we deliver intelligent communication platforms that empower resilient connectivity and spatial intelligence, anytime and anywhere.

Kymeta's core principles define the character and spirit of our employees and focus our experts. We are committed to fostering a workplace rooted in trust by creating a diverse, equitable, and inclusive work environment that is rooted in accountability, employee well-being and corporate social responsibility.
We deliver solutions that delight our customers
